messages:
hari (CS): FYI — Aurora is going live tomorrow AM. They're high-touch and we want a tiny public-facing runbook that customers can follow for first-48h: quick prefill/warmup, batching suggestions, streaming sanity checks, and a 2-question feedback ping. Can someone put together a short customer-friendly checklist + an engineer note with a one-line smoke test?
tori (CS): I can author the checklist. Plan: 1 page PDF + a 1-click 'run smoke tests' script they can paste. Keep language non-technical but include an "engineer note" section for dev teams.
jake (eng-runtime): Ill draft the smoke test and a curl snippet. Minimal smoke test we recommend: a) prefill 12 short warmup calls to prime KV & tokenizer caches, b) send 30 short streamed requests at ~150ms intervals, c) check median chunk latency <1.5s and error rate <1%. If those fail, see troubleshooting steps.
rachel (support): Add an escalation path: If errors >2% over 5m or median gen latency >2s, open urgent ticket and include trace_id + request samples. We'll auto-create a tracking incident if they use the feedback webhook.
jake (eng-runtime): Shareable curl (engineer note):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"small-embed-1","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Expected quick checks to show in doc: HTTP 200, first stream chunk <=1500ms, KV hit rate increases after warmup (>75%). If KV stay low after 12 calls, increase prefill_count to 30 or raise TTL.
tori (CS): For customers: keep it simple — three bullets: 1) Run prefill script (12 requests) 2) Set batch_size suggested by prompt length (short <128 tokens -> 32, medium ~256-512 -> 8-16) 3) Switch to non-streaming if you see repeated truncated chunks, then ping support. Add link to support portal.
rachel (support): Feedback form (2 questions): Q1: "Did the results match your expectations?" (Yes / No). Q2: "If no, brief note". Hook posts to our intake webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/aurora-feedback -> creates ticket. We'll monitor and tag "onboard/aurora".
jake (eng-runtime): Quick troubleshooting table (for doc):
- symptom: "no streaming chunks" -> check API key & network, try non-stream endpoint, run curl above.
- symptom: "low KV hit rate" -> increase prefill_count to 30 or widen TTL, confirm requests use same tenant id.
- symptom: "high latency" -> reduce batch_size, check prompt length distribution, verify region routing.
tori (CS): I'll produce the one-pager with the 3 customer bullets, the 2-question feedback link, and an "engineer note" appendix with the curl + triage table. Will post to #customer-success and DM Aurora CSM by EOD.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: Aurora dedicated warmup Wed 03:30 UTC (prewarm tasks queued).
hari (CS): Perfect. Make sure the doc tells customers exactly what we'll check on our side (KV priming, pool health, recent deploys) so they know next steps. Thanks all :)
